s1_manual.inheritance_rule: Historical PASS is expected-behavior evidence only. Every row returns to PENDIENTE_ENTORNO for the future integrated candidate and must be PASS_REAL on that exact final SHA.
rows: Envío con ratón mantiene comportamiento de foco y produce un único aviso breve ES/EN.

Reset explícito borra consulta/respuesta e inicia conversación nueva.
Respuesta permanece y pausa/reanudación no repite aviso.
Controles incompatibles se omiten/deshabilitan durante pausa.
2001 caracteres no se envían, texto se conserva y error se anuncia.

Envío mantiene foco natural en Enviar; no impone foco al input/respuesta.
Al ocultar, foco queda en Mostrar; invocador visible.
Tras Pausar foco en Reanudar; tras Reanudar foco en Pausar Sabik; tras reset foco en input.
Enter crea nueva línea; Ctrl+Enter envía.
Pausar Sabik se anuncia como botón, sin pressed indebido.
Nombres accesibles de controles observables con lector de pantalla.
320 CSS px: reflow y orden búsqueda → Sabik → resto.
Zoom nativo del navegador al 400 % con reflow.

I01.title: Exact closed identities
I01.requirement: preview base fc5cdfc2; A01 #212; A02 #213; A03 #218; exact heads/trees immutable.

I02.title: Ancestry / no duplicate A01
I02.requirement: A03 must contain A01 and future recipe must not reapply A01 after A03.

I03.title: Exact A02 product delta
I03.requirement: A02 product delta is only sabik/sabik-page.css, identified by exact base/head blobs; A02 QA workflow/test are regression fixtures, not product delta.

I04.title: A01 regression
I04.requirement: Frozen A01 14/14 + exact own/browser test blobs must pass on final integrated candidate.

I05.title: A03 regression
I05.requirement: Frozen A03 12/12 + own suite must pass; A01 remains green.

I06.title: A02 source regression
I06.requirement: A02 L01-L20 exact frozen test must pass against candidate source.

I07.title: A02 dist regression
I07.requirement: A02 L01-L20 exact frozen test must pass against candidate dist.

I08.title: Core automatic regression
I08.requirement: S0 146/146, S1 automatic+extras, S4 unit, V7 28/28 and A11Y closure must pass.

I09.title: Browser/storage regression
I09.requirement: A01 browser source/dist, S1 source/dist and S4 browser/storage source/dist must pass.

I10.title: Historical controls/buttons no-regression
I10.requirement: Manual behavior matrix is expected behavior, not functionality to rediscover.

I11.title: 23 S1 manual controls
I11.requirement: All 23 rows must be PASS_REAL on exact final candidate; historical PASS cannot transfer.

I12.title: Keyboard/focus
I12.requirement: Submit, pause/resume, reset, hide/show, collapse/Escape and conventional navigation must preserve focus semantics.

I13.title: Layout/responsive
I13.requirement: 1920/1440 lateral, 768/390/320 stacked, open/collapsed, long response, results, sticky/internal scroll invariants.

I14.title: Zoom/reduced motion
I14.requirement: 200%/400% reflow checks plus reduced-motion; no essential function depends on animation.

I15.title: B3 visual identity
I15.requirement: PR #181 accepted family and five Web-state SHA-256 identities remain unchanged.

I16.title: Web visual presentation binding
I16.requirement: Accepted SABIK_WEB_VISUAL_PRESENTATION_R01 must bind desktop/mobile, light/dark/transparent, five contexts, safe areas/responsive tokens, no core-master change.

I17.title: Offline/disabled cloud
I17.requirement: Sabik Web remains usable in the explicitly disabled/offline cloud state; no cloud activation is required by this integration.

I18.title: Text-only / voice absent / no autoplay
I18.requirement: Complete text path remains available when voice asset/runtime is absent and no voice autoplay occurs.

I19.title: Storage/privacy
I19.requirement: No conversation/query leakage or unauthorized persistence; source/dist storage behavior remains contract-compliant.

I20.title: High contrast
I20.requirement: High-contrast/current accessibility preference must preserve readable/usable controls and visual context.

I21.title: Errors/recovery
I21.requirement: Technical error, retry, pause/resume and reset recover without losing Safety invariants or trapping controls.

I22.title: No cognitive-state inference
I22.requirement: Safety alone must not infer cognitive state or enable low_intensity; explicit cognitive signal remains allowed by A03 contract.

I23.title: Linux build/source/dist
I23.requirement: Clean Linux build, git diff --check, source/dist tests and reproducible dist inventory.

I24.title: Manifest/provenance
I24.requirement: Final candidate must record exact base/head/tree/merge-base/ordered commits/changed files and origin per commit/final blob.

I25.title: Scope exclusions
I25.requirement: No B3 motion, voice runtime activation, cloud/API activation, duplicate A01, old prototype promotion, or unrelated I0/I1 contamination.

I26.title: Final integrated verdict
I26.requirement: PASS only if I01-I25 automated/evidence gates pass and I11 is 23/23 PASS_REAL on unchanged final HEAD/tree; otherwise BLOCK/PENDING, never inherited PASS.

final_rules.final_pass_requires: I01-I25 PASS + all 23 S1 manual PASS_REAL on same unchanged candidate HEAD/tree
